name: Visucia

attributes.attribute: known from several inscriptions in southwestern France

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Visucia is a Continental Celtic goddess. Her name appears on several inscriptions found in southwestern France. She sometimes stands beside a partner named Viscucius, a name shaped as the masculine version of her own. Her character and her powers remain unclear.

okr.objective: Present Visucia as a Continental Celtic goddess whose powers stay unknown.
key_results: Visucia appears on several inscriptions in southwestern France.
Her consort Viscucius carries the male form of her name.
Her character and powers remain unclear.
okr.evidence: Monaghan, Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore
